# BigQuery requires LAG/LEAD default expressions to be constant:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/navigation_functions.md
# Error text is also covered by GoogleSQL's analytic_lag/lead tests.

SELECT LAG(x, 2, x) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The third argument (the default expression) to LAG must be constant

SELECT LEAD(x, 2, x + 1) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The third argument (the default expression) to LEAD must be constant

SELECT LAG(x, 2, CAST(3 AS INT64) + 4) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> "7"

SELECT LEAD(x, 2, CAST(NULL AS INT64)) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> null

SELECT LEAD(x, 2, 7) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> "7"

SELECT LAG(CAST(x AS FLOAT64), 2, RAND()) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
=> error: The third argument (the default expression) to LAG must be constant
